articles.title: U.S. CFTC rebuffs CME legal stance in consequential fight over perpetual futures
articles.snippet: The future of perps in the U.S. may be at stake as the CFTC argues that CME hasn't shown the new policy is hurting it after the agency OK'd its first bitcoin perp.

articles.title: Strive closes $630M SATS IPO, leaves Bitcoin allocation unspecified
articles.snippet: The Bitcoin treasury company could acquire an estimated 7,372 BTC with its net proceeds, potentially surpassing Metaplanet’s holdings if it allocates the full amount.

articles.title: Alphabet, Microsoft add objections to OKX-ICE proposed tokenized stock platform
articles.snippet: About 25% of the US-listed companies in OKXICE’s initial tokenized stock platform proposal are asking to opt-out of the venture.

articles.title: BlackRock files for third Bitcoin ETF, still no Solana or XRP
articles.snippet: BlackRock’s proposed Bitcoin fund would use options to limit potential losses and gains, adding another strategy to its existing Bitcoin and Ether ETF lineup.

articles.title: Crypto PAC pours $362K into California race voters essentially decided in August
articles.snippet: A Fairshake affiliate is supporting incumbent Aisha Wahab through ads in November, but the congresswoman already won a special election in the district.
